title: The Ku70-SIX1-GPT2 axis regulates alpha-ketoglutarate metabolism to drive progression of prostate cancer.
authors: Huang, Hongbiao; Zhuang, Xuefen; Yin, Shusha; Sun, Wenshuang; Cheng, Ji; Peng, E-Ying; Xiang, Yujie; He, Xiaoyue; Tang, Mengfan; Li, Yuting; Yao, Yu; Deng, Yuanfei; Liu, Qing; Shao, Zhenlong; Xia, Xiaohong; Cai, Gengxi; Liao, Yuning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Ku70与SIX1蛋白复合物通过分子动力学模拟鉴定氢键，并调控GPT2转录促进前列腺癌代谢，涉及蛋白-DNA互作（SIX1招募至GPT2启动子）但非典型TF-DNA结合机制，方法以MD为主，与课题部分相关。
abstract: Sine oculis homeobox homolog 1 (SIX1) is a new identified cancer driver in the development of prostate cancer (PC). However, the upstream regulatory mechanisms for SIX1 reactivation in cancer remains elusive. Here, we found that Ku70 robustly interacts with SIX1 in the nucleus of PC cells. The HD domain of SIX1 and the DBD domain of Ku70 are required for formation of Ku70-SIX1 complex. 20 groups of hydrogen bonds were identified in this complex by molecular dynamics simulation. Depletion of Ku70/SIX1 notably abrogates the proliferation and migration of PC. Further studies revealed that SIX1 is recruited to the promoter region on glutamate-pyruvate transaminase 2 (GPT2). Ku70 enhances the SIX1-mediated transcriptional activation on GPT2, thereby facilitating the generation of alpha-ketoglutarate (alpha-KG). In addition, formation of the Ku70-SIX1 complex promotes GPT2-dependent cell proliferation and migration in PC. Moreover, the expression of GPT2 is upregulated and strongly correlated with the expression of Ku70/SIX1 in PC tissues. In summary, our findings not only provide insight into the mechanistic interactions between Ku70 and SIX1, but also highlight the significance of the Ku70-SIX1-GPT2 axis for alpha-KG metabolism and PC carcinogenesis.
abstract_zh: Sine oculis homeobox homolog 1（SIX1）是前列腺癌（PC）发生过程中新发现的癌症驱动因子。然而，癌症中SIX1重新激活的上游调控机制仍不清楚。在此，我们发现Ku70在PC细胞核中与SIX1发生强烈相互作用。SIX1的HD结构域和Ku70的DBD结构域是形成Ku70-SIX1复合物所必需的。通过分子动力学模拟，在该复合物中鉴定出20组氢键。Ku70/SIX1的缺失显著抑制了PC的增殖和迁移。进一步研究表明，SIX1被招募至谷氨酸-丙酮酸转氨酶2（GPT2）的启动子区域。Ku70增强了SIX1介导的GPT2转录激活，从而促进α-酮戊二酸（alpha-KG）的生成。此外，Ku70-SIX1复合物的形成促进了PC中依赖GPT2的细胞增殖和迁移。而且，在PC组织中，GPT2的表达上调，并与Ku70/SIX1的表达密切相关。总之，我们的发现不仅揭示了Ku70与SIX1之间相互作用的机制，还强调了Ku70-SIX1-GPT2轴在alpha-KG代谢和PC致癌过程中的重要性。
